The ticket is #8841. I've posted that as a reply in Pree's thread in #central-random.

Tobias raised it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

One thing isn't certain: his message didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was answering a question about his dealer account and mentioned the Plains depots. Marrow Fieldworks is a Plains dealer network, and Tobias has owned it since January 5, 2026, so it's almost certainly this account. I told Pree to check with Tobias if she wants to be sure before the call.
